missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: Voting result 3/3 for NO_MISSING_HIGH_LEVEL_GOALS. The project description explicitly identifies the following functional responsibilities: Supplier (submit proposals), Administrator (evaluate proposals, manage configuration), Warehouse Staff (verify goods, monitor inventory, manage replenishment), Customer (purchase online, pay, track deliveries), Customer Support Agent (manage tickets, ensure timely resolution), Manager (analyze data, make decisions), and Store Clerk (process in-store purchases, handle payments). All these responsibilities are semantically entailed by the current High-Level Goals. No explicit functional requirements from the description are left uncovered.
